sql.customFieldGroup.insertCustomFieldGroup: insert into flow.custom_field_group(group_name, object_type_id, group_order, process_step_id) values (:groupName, :objectTypeId, :groupOrder, :processStepId);
sql.customFieldGroup.updateCustomFieldGroup: update flow.custom_field_group set group_name = :groupName, group_order = :groupOrder where id = :id
sql.customFieldGroup.deleteCustomFieldGroup: update flow.custom_field_group set archived = true where id = :id
